newsitem.title: SPAIN: Bank of Spain seen holding rate unchanged - poll.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Spain seen holding rate unchanged - poll.

text.p: The Bank of Spain is likely to maintain its key money market rate unchanged at 6.75 percent on Tuesday at its regular repo auction, a Reuter poll forecast.

All ten financial experts polled by Reuters on Monday ruled out any possible cut, after the Spanish central bank sanctioned its sixth official rate reduction this year at its last regular repo on October 3 in response to an austere budget package.
The Bank of Spain cut interest rates by 50 basis points from 7.25 percent.
The central bank is now focusing on inflation, but many forecast another interest rate reduction before year end. Some of these see a cut of as much as 50 basis points.
In September, Spanish consumer price index rose a lower-than-expected 0.2 percent following a 0.3 percent gain in August. Year-on-year, inflation fell to 3.6 percent from 3.7 percent in August.
